method: Independent data-only Python audit. Original scripts read as text, never imported or executed; no model inference or pickle deserialization.

source_partitions.training: 1,553,434 declared in earlier authenticated source-pool evidence; full training pool not rescanned by this audit
source_partitions.test_pool: 332,893 in earlier authenticated source-pool evidence; actual XAI frozen sample verified here

primary_calibration.selection: 5-fold StratifiedKFold by prediction correctness, shuffle=True, seed0, validation only
primary_calibration.cv_fold_provenance: Audit derivative recreating round-robin stratified class allocation and MT19937 shuffle. Original per-fold membership records are not retained; no calibrator fits were rerun.

overlap_conventions.nonlabel_source_csv_string: SHA256 of UTF8 compact JSON sorted [column,original CSV string] pairs; Attack_type and Attack_label excluded. This measures exact retained source-value equality, not physical-flow identity.
overlap_conventions.rendered_input: Exact flow_block string as in retained logs, reconstructed independently using config14fields/presence rules. Different truth labels can share a block.
overlap_conventions.index_space_warning: test/realistic integer keys use different sample-relative offset spaces; do not intersect integer keys directly. Validation offsets refer to original validation CSV.

limitations: Temperature was fitted on the same 3,582 rows used for conformal quantiles; ordinary split-conformal finite-sample coverage is not independently authenticated by this procedure.
Cross-draw exact source-value and rendered-input overlap must be reported; distinct source partitions do not establish feature/input independence.

No explicit train/test duplicate or rendered-input exclusion is present in original draw construction. Fitted detector/checkpoint training membership is not established by this audit; existing training-pool overlap evidence remains separate.
Five-fold CV is disjoint by row position, not grouped by rendered input. Duplicate rendered blocks can occur across fit/heldout folds.
This authenticates retained artifacts and output-to-draw bindings; it does not independently establish every historical execution timestamp or physical-flow independence.
